title: John Coltrane - A Love Supreme [Full Album] (1965)
summary: The full 1965 John Coltrane album A Love Supreme, in four parts: Acknowledgement, Resolution, Pursuance and Psalm. It features Coltrane's quartet with McCoy Tyner, Jimmy Garrison and Elvin Jones.
why: Mentioned as an example of spiritual, non-romantic love in music and as a demanding jazz work that is hard for the uninitiated.
